```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(UCell)
library(ggnewscale)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)


theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 11))

# Palette: WT = grey, mCh- = teal, mCh+ = coral
cond_pal <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
cond_order <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")

label_condition <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("WT",     x) ~ "WT",
    grepl("mCh-",  x) ~ "mCh-",
    grepl("mCh\\+", x) ~ "mCh+",
    TRUE               ~ x
  )
}
```

# Overview

Tests whether *Het mCh+* and *Het mCh−* HSC show elevated stress / senescence
transcriptional programmes compared to WT, within each cluster.

**Approach:**

1. **Signatures** — in-house (DE-derived) + public MSigDB stress/senescence genesets
2. **UCell scores** — rank-based per-cell scoring (no background gene bias)
3. **Pairwise testing** — Wilcoxon test per geneset × cluster × comparison
   (WT vs mCh−, WT vs mCh+, mCh− vs mCh+); BH correction across all tests
4. **Violin plots** — genesets significant in ≥ 1 cluster × comparison (padj < 0.05)
5. **ORA** — over-representation of stress genesets in per-cluster upregulated genes

---

# 1  Signature definition

## In-house signature

Genes upregulated in Het (mCh+ or mCh−) vs WT (padj ≤ 0.05, log FC ≥ 0.25)
filtered for stress / chaperone / UPR / DNA-damage annotations.

```{r inhouse-sig}
stress_patterns <- c(
  "^Hspa", "^Hspb", "^Hspc", "^Hspd", "^Hspe", "^Hsph", "^Hsp90", "^Dnaj",
  "^Atf[34]$", "Ddit3", "Eif2ak3", "Ern1", "Atf6", "Hspa5", "Hyou1", "Calr",
  "^Sod[12]", "Cat", "^Gpx", "^Prdx", "^Txn", "Nfe2l2", "Hmox1", "Sqstm1",
  "Trp53", "Cdkn1a", "Gadd45", "^Brca", "Rad51",
  "^Atg", "Becn1", "Map1lc3",
  "Nfkb1", "Tnf", "Il6", "Cxcl1", "Cxcl2",
  "Hif1a", "Vegfa", "Ldha", "Pgk1", "Eno1"
)
stress_regex <- paste(stress_patterns, collapse = "|")

de_hsc <- targets::tar_read(delegate_allvsall_markers_hsc)
inhouse_stress <- de_hsc |>
  dplyr::filter(padj <= 0.05, log_fc >= 0.25,
                grepl("mCh", group1), grepl("WT", group2)) |>
  dplyr::pull(feature) |>
  unique() |>
  (\(x) x[grepl(stress_regex, x, ignore.case = TRUE)])()

rm(de_hsc); gc()

cat("In-house stress signature:", length(inhouse_stress), "genes\n")
```

```{r inhouse-table}
DT::datatable(data.frame(gene = sort(inhouse_stress)), rownames = FALSE,
              caption = "In-house stress genes (Het vs WT, HSC)")
```

## Public signatures

```{r public-sigs}
stress_pattern <- paste(c(
  "STRESS", "HEAT_SHOCK", "HSP", "CHAPERONE", "ER_STRESS",
  "OXIDATIVE", "REACTIVE_OXYGEN", "_ROS", "HYPOXIA",
  "DNA_DAMAGE", "DNA_REPAIR", "SENESCEN", "P53", "TP53",
  "APOPTOSIS", "AUTOPHAGY", "INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE", "INTERFERON"
), collapse = "|")

clean_names <- function(x) {
  x |>
    gsub("HALLMARK_|REACTOME_|GOBP_|GOCC_|GOMF_|WP_|KEGG_", "", x = _) |>
    tolower() |> gsub("_", " ", x = _) |>
    tools::toTitleCase() |> substr(1, 50)
}

sig_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(
  c("H", "C5"),
  ~ msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = .x) |>
      dplyr::select(gs_name, gs_collection = gs_cat, gene_symbol)
) |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl(stress_pattern, gs_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(gs_name, gs_collection) |>
  dplyr::summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_symbol)), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(lengths(genes) >= 20, lengths(genes) <= 500) |>
  dplyr::arrange(gs_collection, gs_name) |>
  dplyr::mutate(label = clean_names(gs_name)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(label, .keep_all = TRUE)

public_sigs <- setNames(sig_tbl$genes, sig_tbl$label)
all_sigs    <- c(list(`In-house stress` = inhouse_stress), public_sigs)

cat("Total signatures:", length(all_sigs), "\n")
purrr::iwalk(all_sigs, ~ cat(" ", .y, ":", length(.x), "genes\n"))
```

```{r sig-table}
purrr::imap_dfr(all_sigs, ~ data.frame(signature = .y, gene = .x)) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollY = "350px"))
```

---

# 2  UCell scores — HSC

```{r ucell-scores}
srt_hsc    <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc)
hsc_cl_col <- grep("sNN.*res\\.0\\.9$", colnames(srt_hsc@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]

# Rank-based per-cell UCell scoring
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(srt_hsc, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
ucell_scores <- UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell(
  matrix   = expr_mat,
  features = all_sigs,
  ncores   = 4
)
# ucell_scores: cells × genesets (colnames have "_UCell" suffix — strip it)
colnames(ucell_scores) <- gsub("_UCell$", "", colnames(ucell_scores))

# Build long data.frame: cell × geneset × score + metadata
scores_df <- ucell_scores |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    srt_hsc@meta.data |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
      dplyr::select(cell_id,
                    cluster     = dplyr::all_of(hsc_cl_col),
                    sample.name),
    by = "cell_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster   = as.character(cluster),
    condition = label_condition(sample.name)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(names(all_sigs)),
    names_to  = "geneset",
    values_to = "score"
  )

rm(srt_hsc, expr_mat, ucell_scores); gc()

cat("Scored", dplyr::n_distinct(scores_df$cell_id), "cells ×",
    dplyr::n_distinct(scores_df$geneset), "genesets\n")
cat("Clusters:", paste(sort(unique(scores_df$cluster)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Conditions:", paste(sort(unique(scores_df$condition)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

---

# 3  Pairwise testing per geneset × cluster

Wilcoxon rank-sum test for each geneset × cluster × pairwise condition comparison.
BH correction applied across all tests.

```{r pairwise-test}
pairs <- list(
  `WT vs mCh-`  = c("WT", "mCh-"),
  `WT vs mCh+`  = c("WT", "mCh+"),
  `mCh- vs mCh+` = c("mCh-", "mCh+")
)

pairwise_res <- scores_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(geneset, cluster) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    d <- .x
    purrr::map_dfr(names(pairs), function(pair_name) {
      g <- pairs[[pair_name]]
      x <- d$score[d$condition == g[1]]
      y <- d$score[d$condition == g[2]]
      if (length(x) < 3 || length(y) < 3) return(NULL)
      wt <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)
      tibble::tibble(
        comparison  = pair_name,
        n_g1        = length(x),
        n_g2        = length(y),
        median_g1   = median(x),
        median_g2   = median(y),
        median_diff = median(y) - median(x),
        pval        = wt$p.value
      )
    })
  }) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"))

cat("Total tests:", nrow(pairwise_res), "\n")
cat("Significant (padj < 0.001):", sum(pairwise_res$padj < 0.001, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r test-table}
pairwise_res |>
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.001) |>
  dplyr::arrange(padj) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pval        = signif(pval, 3),
    padj        = signif(padj, 3),
    median_diff = round(median_diff, 4)
  ) |>
  DT::datatable(
    rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
    caption  = "Significant pairwise comparisons (padj < 0.05)",
    options  = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
```

---

# 4  Violin plots — significant genesets

Genesets with padj < 0.001 in at least one cluster × comparison.
Each panel = one cluster; fill = condition; significance brackets from the pairwise test.

```{r sig-genesets}
sig_genesets <- pairwise_res |>
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.001) |>
  dplyr::pull(geneset) |>
  unique() |>
  sort()

cat("Significant genesets:", length(sig_genesets), "\n")
cat(paste(sig_genesets, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

```{r violin-fn}
# Significance label from padj
sig_label <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ ""
  )
}

#' Violin plot for one geneset across all clusters, split by condition.
#' Significance brackets drawn for comparisons with padj < 0.05.
plot_geneset_violin <- function(gs_name, scores, tests) {
  df <- scores |>
    dplyr::filter(geneset == gs_name) |>
    dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = cond_order))

  clusters <- sort(unique(df$cluster))

  # Per-cluster significance annotations
  annot <- tests |>
    dplyr::filter(geneset == gs_name, padj < 0.05) |>
    dplyr::mutate(label = sig_label(padj))

  # y-position for brackets: slightly above per-cluster max
  y_range <- range(df$score, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_step  <- diff(y_range) * 0.10
  pair_y  <- c(`WT vs mCh-` = y_range[2] + y_step,
               `WT vs mCh+` = y_range[2] + 2 * y_step,
               `mCh- vs mCh+` = y_range[2] + 3 * y_step)

  # x-positions of conditions within each facet
  x_pos <- setNames(seq_along(cond_order), cond_order)
  bracket_df <- annot |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      x_left  = dplyr::case_when(
        comparison == "WT vs mCh-"   ~ x_pos["WT"],
        comparison == "WT vs mCh+"   ~ x_pos["WT"],
        comparison == "mCh- vs mCh+" ~ x_pos["mCh-"]
      ),
      x_right = dplyr::case_when(
        comparison == "WT vs mCh-"   ~ x_pos["mCh-"],
        comparison == "WT vs mCh+"   ~ x_pos["mCh+"],
        comparison == "mCh- vs mCh+" ~ x_pos["mCh+"]
      ),
      y_pos = pair_y[comparison]
    )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(condition, score, fill = condition)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7, trim = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA,
                 fill = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "line", aes(group = 1),
                 colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "solid") +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", aes(group = 1),
                 colour = "grey20", size = 1.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_pal, guide = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~ cluster, nrow = 1) +
    labs(title = gs_name, x = NULL, y = "UCell score") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text  = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )

  # Add significance brackets per cluster
  if (nrow(bracket_df) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +   # brackets don't need fill
      geom_segment(
        data = bracket_df,
        aes(x = x_left, xend = x_right, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = bracket_df,
        aes(x = (x_left + x_right) / 2, y = y_pos + y_step * 0.3,
            label = label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, vjust = 0
      )
  }

  p
}
```

# 5  Significance heatmap

-log10(padj) for every geneset × cluster × comparison.
Only genesets significant in ≥ 1 test shown.

```{r sig-heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
if (length(sig_genesets) > 0) {
  heat_df <- pairwise_res |>
    dplyr::filter(geneset %in% sig_genesets) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_log_p  = pmin(-log10(pmax(padj, 1e-10)), 10),
      # Condition: extract mCh- / mCh+ / both from comparison string
      het_cond   = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("mCh\\+", comparison) & grepl("mCh-", comparison) ~ "mCh- vs mCh+",
        grepl("mCh\\+", comparison) ~ "mCh+",
        grepl("mCh-",   comparison) ~ "mCh-",
        TRUE                        ~ comparison
      ),
      col_key    = paste0(cluster, " | ", het_cond)
    )

  # Column order: sort by cluster then condition
  col_order <- heat_df |>
    dplyr::distinct(col_key, cluster, het_cond) |>
    dplyr::arrange(as.integer(cluster),
                   factor(het_cond, levels = c("mCh-", "mCh+", "mCh- vs mCh+"))) |>
    dplyr::pull(col_key)

  heat_mat <- heat_df |>
    dplyr::select(geneset, col_key, neg_log_p) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from  = col_key, values_from = neg_log_p,
                       values_fill = 0) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames("geneset") |>
    as.matrix()
  heat_mat <- heat_mat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]

  # Column annotation data
  ann_col <- heat_df |>
    dplyr::distinct(col_key, cluster, het_cond) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(col_key, col_order))

  cl_vals   <- ann_col$cluster          # cluster label per column, in col_order
  cond_vals <- ann_col$het_cond         # condition per column, in col_order
  n_col     <- length(col_order)

  # Cluster bar: grey fill with cluster number as text (ComplexHeatmap AnnotationFunction)
  cluster_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::AnnotationFunction(
    fun = function(index, k, n) {
      for (i in seq_along(index)) {
        v <- cl_vals[index[i]]
        grid::grid.rect(
          x      = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
          y      = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
          width  = grid::unit(1 / length(index), "npc"),
          height = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
          gp     = grid::gpar(fill = "#cccccc", col = "white", lwd = 0.3))
        grid::grid.text(
          as.character(v),
          x  = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
          y  = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
          gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold", col = "#333333"))
      }
    },
    which = "column", n = n_col, height = grid::unit(5, "mm"))

  cond_pal <- c(`mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51", `mCh- vs mCh+` = "#9b59b6")

  col_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    Cluster   = cluster_anno,
    Condition = cond_vals,
    col       = list(Condition = cond_pal),
    annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    show_legend          = c(Cluster = FALSE, Condition = TRUE),
    annotation_height    = grid::unit(c(5, 4), "mm")
  )

  # Effect size matrix: median_diff, NA for non-significant cells (shown as grey)
  diff_mat <- heat_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(value = dplyr::if_else(padj < 0.05, median_diff, NA_real_)) |>
    dplyr::select(geneset, col_key, value) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from  = col_key, values_from = value,
                       values_fill = NA_real_) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames("geneset") |>
    as.matrix()
  diff_mat <- diff_mat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]

  lim <- max(abs(diff_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
  col_fun_diff <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-lim, 0, lim),
                                       c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"))

  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    diff_mat,
    col                  = col_fun_diff,
    na_col               = "grey88",
    name                 = "\u0394 median\n(UCell)",
    top_annotation       = col_anno,
    cluster_rows         = TRUE,
    cluster_columns      = TRUE,
    column_labels        = cond_vals,
    column_names_rot     = 45,
    column_names_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
    row_names_gp         = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_title         = "\u0394 median UCell score (g2 \u2212 g1) \u2014 grey = not significant (padj \u2265 0.05)",
    column_title_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "\u0394 median\n(UCell)")
  )
}
```


# 6  ORA — stress genesets × cluster (HSC)

Over-representation analysis (Fisher's exact test via `fgsea::fora()`) of each stress /
senescence signature against upregulated genes per cluster × comparison.

- **Foreground** — upregulated genes in a given cluster × comparison (padj ≤ 0.05, log FC > 0)
- **Background** — all genes tested in that cluster × comparison

```{r ora-run}
de_hsc_full <- targets::tar_read(delegate_allvsall_markers_hsc)

comparisons <- list(
  `mCh- vs WT` = list(g1_pat = "mCh-",  g2_pat = "WT"),
  `mCh+ vs WT` = list(g1_pat = "mCh\\+", g2_pat = "WT")
)

clusters_ora <- sort(unique(de_hsc_full$cluster))

run_ora_stress <- function(de_df, sig_list, padj_thr = 0.05, lfc_thr = 0) {
  purrr::map_dfr(names(comparisons), function(comp_name) {
    cfg     <- comparisons[[comp_name]]
    de_comp <- de_df |>
      dplyr::filter(grepl(cfg$g1_pat, group1), grepl(cfg$g2_pat, group2))
    purrr::map_dfr(clusters_ora, function(cl) {
      de_cl      <- dplyr::filter(de_comp, cluster == cl)
      if (nrow(de_cl) == 0) return(NULL)
      universe   <- unique(de_cl$feature)
      foreground <- de_cl |>
        dplyr::filter(padj <= padj_thr, log_fc > lfc_thr) |>
        dplyr::pull(feature) |> unique()
      if (length(foreground) < 3) return(NULL)
      purrr::map_dfr(names(sig_list), function(sig_name) {
        genes_use <- intersect(sig_list[[sig_name]], universe)
        if (length(genes_use) < 3) return(NULL)
        res <- fgsea::fora(
          pathways = list(sig = genes_use),
          genes    = foreground,
          universe = universe,
          minSize  = 3
        )
        if (nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)
        tibble::tibble(
          comparison    = comp_name,
          cluster       = as.character(cl),
          geneset       = sig_name,
          pval          = res$pval[1],
          padj          = res$padj[1],
          overlap       = res$overlap[1],
          pathway_size  = length(genes_use),
          foreground_n  = length(foreground),
          universe_n    = length(universe),
          overlap_genes = list(res$overlapGenes[[1]])
        )
      })
    })
  })
}

ora_stress <- run_ora_stress(de_hsc_full, all_sigs) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fold_enrichment = (overlap / foreground_n) / (pathway_size / universe_n),
    log2_fe         = log2(pmax(fold_enrichment, 1e-3)),
    sig             = padj < 0.001,
    overlap_ratio   = overlap / pathway_size
  )

rm(de_hsc_full); gc()

cat("ORA complete:", nrow(ora_stress), "tests\n")
cat("Significant (padj < 0.001):", sum(ora_stress$sig, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## Bubble plot

```{r ora-bubble-fn}
ora_bubble_gs_order <- ora_stress |>
  dplyr::filter(sig) |>
  dplyr::group_by(geneset) |>
  dplyr::summarise(min_padj = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(min_padj) |>
  dplyr::pull(geneset)

plot_ora_bubble <- function(comp_name, gs_order,
                            show_y = TRUE, show_legend = TRUE) {
  df <- ora_stress |>
    dplyr::filter(comparison == comp_name, geneset %in% gs_order) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      geneset = factor(geneset, levels = rev(gs_order)),
      cluster = factor(cluster, levels = sort(unique(cluster)))
    )
  if (nrow(df) == 0)
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = comp_name, subtitle = "No data") + theme_void())

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cluster, y = geneset)) +
    geom_point(data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, !sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio),
               shape = 21, fill = "grey88", colour = "white",
               stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, sig),
               aes(size = overlap_ratio, fill = log2_fe),
               colour = "black", shape = 21, stroke = 0.4, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours  = c("white", "#fc8d59", "#d73027"),
                         na.value = "grey90", name = "log2 fold\nenrichment") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Overlap\nratio", range = c(1, 8)) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = comp_name) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 0, size = 9),
          axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid      = element_line(colour = "grey93"),
          legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
          plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))

  if (!show_y)
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
  p
}
```

```{r ora-bubble}
#| fig.width: 14
#| fig.height: !expr max(4, 0.28 * length(ora_bubble_gs_order) + 1.5)

if (length(ora_bubble_gs_order) == 0) {
  cat("No significant stress genesets found in ORA.\n")
} else {
  comp_names <- names(comparisons)
  p_left  <- plot_ora_bubble(comp_names[1], ora_bubble_gs_order,
                             show_y = TRUE,  show_legend = FALSE)
  p_right <- plot_ora_bubble(comp_names[2], ora_bubble_gs_order,
                             show_y = FALSE, show_legend = TRUE)
  p_left + p_right +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1)) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title   = "HSC — stress / senescence ORA per cluster",
      caption = "Filled: padj < 0.05  |  Size: overlap / geneset size  |  Colour: log2 fold enrichment",
      theme   = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
    )
}
```

```{r ora-sig-table}
ora_stress |>

  dplyr::arrange(comparison, cluster, padj) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    padj            = signif(padj, 3),

    overlap_ratio   = round(overlap_ratio, 3),
    overlap_genes   = purrr::map_chr(overlap_genes,
                                     ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ", "))

  dplyr::select(comparison, cluster, geneset, fold_enrichment, padj,
                overlap, pathway_size, overlap_genes) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                caption  = "Significant stress / senescence ORA results (padj < 0.05)",
                options  = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE))
```

```{r stress_genes_expr_heatmap, fig.height=10, fig.width=14}
feats <- ora_stress |>
  dplyr::filter(sig) |>
  dplyr::arrange(padj) |>
  tidyr::unnest(overlap_genes) |>
  dplyr::count(cluster, overlap_genes) |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 1) |>
  dplyr::pull(overlap_genes) |>
  unique()

if (!exists("mpn_processed_hsc"))
  mpn_processed_hsc <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc)

mat <- AverageExpression(
  mpn_processed_hsc,
  group.by      = c("sample.name", "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5"),
  assays        = "SCT",
  layer         = "data",
  features      = feats,
  return.seurat = FALSE
)

# Row-scale then clamp to ±4
mat_sc <- t(scale(t(mat$SCT)))
mat_sc <- pmin(pmax(mat_sc, -4), 4)

# Pre-compute row clustering so modules can be cut and reused downstream
row_dend   <- hclust(dist(mat_sc), method = "ward.D2")
N_MODULES  <- 4L   # adjust to match visible blocks
row_modules <- cutree(row_dend, k = N_MODULES)
row_modules <- factor(paste0("M", row_modules),
                      levels = paste0("M", unique(row_modules[row_dend$order])))
cat("Row modules:\n")
print(table(row_modules))

# Parse column names → cluster (last numeric token) + sample (everything before)
col_nm      <- colnames(mat_sc)
cl_vals_e   <- sub(".*_([0-9]+)$", "\\1", col_nm)
samp_vals_e <- sub("_[0-9]+$",     "",    col_nm)

# Cluster bar: grey fill + number as text
n_col_e <- length(col_nm)
cluster_anno_e <- ComplexHeatmap::AnnotationFunction(
  fun = function(index, k, n) {
    for (i in seq_along(index)) {
      v <- cl_vals_e[index[i]]
      grid::grid.rect(
        x      = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
        y      = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
        width  = grid::unit(1 / length(index), "npc"),
        height = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
        gp     = grid::gpar(fill = "#cccccc", col = "white", lwd = 0.3))
      grid::grid.text(
        as.character(v),
        x  = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
        y  = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold", col = "#333333"))
    }
  },
  which = "column", n = n_col_e, height = grid::unit(5, "mm"))

# Sample palette: map each sample to its condition colour via label_condition()
samp_levels <- sort(unique(samp_vals_e))
samp_pal_e  <- setNames(cond_pal[label_condition(samp_levels)], samp_levels)

col_anno_e <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Cluster = cluster_anno_e,
  Sample  = samp_vals_e,
  col     = list(Sample = samp_pal_e),
  annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend          = c(Cluster = FALSE, Sample = TRUE),
  annotation_height    = grid::unit(c(5, 4), "mm")
)

col_fun_e <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-4, 0, 4), c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"))

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  mat_sc,
  col                  = col_fun_e,
  name                 = "Row-scaled\nexpr.",
  top_annotation       = col_anno_e,
  cluster_rows         = as.dendrogram(row_dend),
  cluster_columns      = TRUE,
  row_split            = 4,
  column_split         = 4,
  column_names_rot     = 45,
  column_names_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 0),
  row_names_gp         = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_title         = "Average SCT expression — stress overlap genes",
  column_title_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row-scaled\nexpr.", at = c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4))
)
```
